content:
We have functional groups list includes 'aliphatic hydroxyls' and 't-butyldimethylsilyl'. Good.

Now we need to search template catalog by criteria: molecule_smiles is given: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need functional_groups_broken: ['t-butyldimethylsilyl']? Actually forward reaction breaks TBS group (the protecting group) and forms aliphatic hydroxyl. So broken group is t-butyldimethylsilyl, formed group is aliphatic hydroxyls. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

Let's call with limit maybe 5.
